For a USB-C laptop charger, I recommend a 65W or 100W USB-C Power Delivery (USB-C PD) charger. The right wattage depends on your laptop.

Charger wattage

	

Best for




45W

	

Small, lightweight laptops




65W

	

MacBook Air, most ultrabooks




100W

	

Larger laptops, MacBook Pro, high-performance laptops




140W+

	

High-power laptops that support USB-C fast charging

My default recommendation: A 100W GaN USB-C charger. It's compact, versatile, and can charge most USB-C laptops.

Recommended chargers

Anker Nano Charger, 100W Foldable MacBook Charger

$35.99

Compact 100W charger, good for travel and everyday laptop charging.

Anker Prime Charger (100W, 3 Ports, GaN)

$69.99

Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port for charging multiple devices.

Use a USB-C cable rated for at least 100W, and confirm your laptop supports USB-C Power Delivery.

What laptop do you have? For example, MacBook Air M3, Dell XPS 15, HP Spectre, or Lenovo ThinkPad. I can recommend the right charger for your exact model.
